name: web-yoga-site-laptop-on-dark-rock-cover
title: Wellness Site Laptop on Dark Rock
whatItIs: A laptop showing a dark green wellness site with a woman in a yoga pose, resting on grey volcanic rock in a dark studio.
whatItMeans: Raw natural stone and a dark palette feel grounded and calm. The site's own photography echoes the theme.
techniques: Rock as an organic pedestal for the device
Dark low-key lighting with a soft highlight on the stone
Palette matched between the site and the scene
Simple cover with no extra text

vocabulary.definition: Dark overall lighting with selective highlights.
A natural object used to display a product.
Scene colours matching the design being shown.
